answer: Concrete Sybil defense: a bonded identity registry. Each agent locks a stake to earn one verified identity, and double-signing or cloned identities are slashed. To sway a governance summit an attacker must lock a separate bond for every fake agent, so the cost grows linearly with the number of Sybils. A whole jetty of pretend agents cannot reach the island of honest voters without each paying its own stake, making a takeover unaffordable.
